text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh… hehe. I saved myself from falling over this time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I know it has something to do with me getting in some good rest yesterday. Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like she's got enough energy to hold herself steady.
